name: Recital AC
title: REPORT on the annual report on the activities of the European Ombudsman in 2024
part_text: AC. whereas the Ombudsman conducted an inquiry following deaths in the Mediterranean Sea, which revealed the existence of serious shortcomings in Frontex’s role in search and rescue operations, including failure to ensure that Frontex’s fundamental rights monitors are sufficiently involved in decision-making on maritime emergencies and a lack of Frontex internal guidelines on issuing emergency signals; whereas the Ombudsman underscored that there is no single accountability mechanism at EU level that could independently investigate the roles of national authorities, Frontex and the Commission; whereas such accountability is essential in order to ensure compliance with fundamental rights and transparency obligations;
